arxiv-2012-07700.title: Role of spatial patterns in fracture of disordered multiphase materials
arxiv-2012-07700.creator: Rajat Pratap Singh Parihar, Dhiwakar V. Mani, Anuradha Banerjee, R.Rajesh
arxiv-2012-07700.description: Abstract Multi-phase materials, such as composite materials, exhibit multiple competing failure mechanisms during the growth of a macroscopic defect. For the simulation of the overall fracture process in such materials, we develop a two-phase spring network model that accounts for the architecture between the different components as well as the respective disorders in their failure characteristics.

arxiv-2108-13330.title: A Novel Regularization for Higher Accuracy in the Solution of 3D Stokes Flow
arxiv-2108-13330.creator: J. Thomas Beale, Christina Jones, Jillian Reale, Svetlana Tlupova
arxiv-2108-13330.description: Abstract Many problems in fluid dynamics are effectively modeled as Stokes flows - slow, viscous flows where the Reynolds number is small. Boundary integral equations are often used to solve these problems, where the fundamental solutions for the fluid velocity are the Stokeslet and stresslet.

arxiv-2404-08821.title: Constrained C-Test Generation via Mixed-Integer Programming
arxiv-2404-08821.creator: Ji-Ung Lee, Marc E. Pfetsch, Iryna Gurevych, Technical University of Darmstadt, Hessian AI
arxiv-2404-08821.description: Abstract This work proposes a novel method to generate C-Tests; a deviated form of cloze tests (a gap filling exercise) where only the last part of a word is turned into a gap. In contrast to previous works that only consider varying the gap size or gap placement to achieve locally optimal solutions, we propose a mixed-integer programming (MIP) approach.

arxiv-2404-17384.title: Statistical theory of the broadband two-plasmon decay instability
arxiv-2404-17384.creator: R. T. Ruskov \aff 1 \corresp, R. Bingham \aff 2,3, L. O. Silva \aff 4,1, M. Harper \aff 5, R. Aboushelbaya \aff 1, J. F. Myatt \aff 6, P. A. Norreys \aff 1,7
arxiv-2404-17384.description: Abstract There is renewed interest in direct-drive inertial confinement fusion, following the milestone December 2022 3.15 MJ ignition result on the National Ignition Facility. A key obstacle is the control of the two-plasmon decay instability. Here, recent advances in inhomogeneous turbulence theory are applied to the broadband parametric instability problem for the first time.

arxiv-2408-15759.title: Plane quartics and heptagons
arxiv-2408-15759.creator: Daniele Agostini, Daniel Plaumann, Rainer Sinn, Jannik Lennart Wesner
arxiv-2408-15759.description: Abstract Every polygon with n n vertices in the complex projective plane is naturally associated with its adjoint curve of degree n − 3 n-3 . Hence the adjoint of a heptagon is a plane quartic. We prove that a general plane quartic is the adjoint of exactly 864 distinct complex heptagons.

pmc-10674763.title: Translational Challenges and Prospective Solutions in the Implementation of Biomimetic Delivery Systems
pmc-10674763.creator: Zhe Wang, Xinpei Wang, Wanting Xu, Yongxiao Li, Ruizhi Lai, Xiaohui Qiu, Xu Chen, Zhidong Chen, Bobin Mi, Meiying Wu, Junqing Wang, Anna Angela Barba, Juan José Torrado
pmc-10674763.description: Biomimetic delivery systems (BDSs), inspired by the intricate designs of biological systems, have emerged as a groundbreaking paradigm in nanomedicine, offering unparalleled advantages in therapeutic delivery. These systems, encompassing platforms such as liposomes, protein-based nanoparticles, extracellular vesicles, and polysaccharides, are lauded for their targeted delivery, minimized side effects, and enhanced therapeutic outcomes.

pmc-11360355.title: Camera-Radar Fusion with Radar Channel Extension and Dual-CBAM-FPN for Object Detection
pmc-11360355.creator: Xiyan Sun, Yaoyu Jiang, Hongmei Qin, Jingjing Li, Yuanfa Ji
pmc-11360355.description: When it comes to road environment perception, millimeter-wave radar with a camera facilitates more reliable detection than a single sensor. However, the limited utilization of radar features and insufficient extraction of important features remain pertinent issues, especially with regard to the detection of small and occluded objects.

pmc-11531247.title: Effect of Weight-Bearing and Mobilization After Treatment With Microfracture in Osteochondral Lesions of the Talus in Rabbits
pmc-11531247.creator: Semih Ak, Bekir E Kilinc, Olcay Eren, Ahmet O Akpolat, Alev Cumbul, Baris Yilmaz
pmc-11531247.description: Background: The aim of this study is to comparatively evaluate the effect of early weight bearing on recovery after treatment with the microfracture (MF) method in a rabbit model of osteochondral lesions (OCLs) of the talus.Materials and methods: The study was carried out on 24 tali of 12 white rabbits. Experimental animals were divided into two groups.

pmc-11578213.title: Treatment of Alar Deformity After Cosmetic Surgery
pmc-11578213.creator: Norihiro Ohba, Goichi Haraoka, Mayuko Ohba, Norio Takahashi
pmc-11578213.description: Background:Nasal alar deformity after cosmetic surgery, including nostril sill notching, alar flattening, and a shallow and indistinct alar-facial crease, commonly results from overresection. We developed revision methods for postoperative alar deformity, and applied them from 2016 to 2022 to the revision of 16 cases, consisting of 1 male and 15 female patients, with a median age of 28.5 years.

pmc-12530997.title: From Rich to Poor: A Decomposition Analysis of Socioeconomic Inequality in Health-related Quality of Life in Iran
pmc-12530997.creator: Satar Rezaei
pmc-12530997.description: ObjectivesSocioeconomic status (SES) is a well-established predictor of health outcomes across an individual’s lifespan. People from lower socioeconomic backgrounds generally have shorter life expectancies and lower levels of health-related quality of life (HRQoL) compared with those from higher-income groups. This study aimed to quantify income-related inequalities in HRQoL among adults in Iran.

pmc-12590595.title: Pet ownership and risk of depression: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12590595.creator: Reza Moshfeghinia, Salma Rostamipourfard, Mohammadsadegh Kamran, Sara Mostafavi, Fahimeh Golabi, Getinet Ayano, Jamshid Ahmadi
pmc-12590595.description: BackgroundPet ownership is often believed to confer psychological benefits, such as reducing loneliness and providing emotional support. However, evidence on its relationship with depression is mixed, and no clear consensus currently exists. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between pet ownership and the risk of depression.MethodsA comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis were performed following PRISMA guidelines.

pmc-12650864.title: Novel Variants in Sperm Mitochondrial Cytochrome C Oxidase II (MT-CO2) Gene Associated with Asthenozoospermia in Jordan
pmc-12650864.creator: Mazhar Salim Al Zoubi, Razan N AlQuraan, Asmaa Al-Smadi, Mohammad A AlSmadi, Manal AbuAlArja, Almuthanna K Alkaraki, Bahaa Al-Trad, Raed M Al-Zoubi, Khalid Al-Batayneh, Huafeng Wang
pmc-12650864.description: Background: Asthenozoospermia is defined as a condition in which the total motility of sperm in a semen sample is less than 40%. Due to impairing sperm motility, asthenozoospermia was linked to different mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) alterations. The current study aimed to investigate the relationship between MT-CO2 gene variants and the development of asthenozoospermia and male infertility in the Jordanian population.

pmc-12965160.title: Laryngopharyngeal Reflux: Historical Perspectives, Current Diagnostics and Therapies, and Remaining Challenges
pmc-12965160.creator: Callie Cuff, Rena Yadlapati
pmc-12965160.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryThe concept of laryngopharyngeal reflux has evolved since it was first used to describe the retrograde flow of gastric contents into the upper airway leading to upper airway symptoms. Decades of cross-disciplinary research have led to our current understanding of this process, which emphasizes differentiating laryngopharyngeal reflux disease (characterized by symptoms with objective evidence of reflux) from laryngopharyngeal symptoms (which can occur with or without pathological reflux).

uslaw-usc-t54-s302505.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s302505.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 3025 (Certification Of Local Governments). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any local government— (1) that is certified under this chapter shall be eligible for funds under section 302902(c)(4) of this title; and (2) that is certified, or making efforts to become certified, under this chapter shall carry out any responsibilities.
